_readme: Shared instruments and every copy of them. tools/vendor_check.py hashes the
comment-stripped core of each copy and fails if any differs from the digest.
Comments are excluded on purpose: a vendored copy SHOULD carry its own header
saying where it came from and what it is scoped to. The logic must not differ.
Canonical home for shared instruments in this project is geometry/tools/.
Other repositories vendor from here and record the same digest in their own
manifest. To change a shared instrument: edit the canonical copy, re-vendor,
run --update, review the diff, commit. Never --update to silence a difference

conclusion_scan.note: The fixtures file deliberately restates the scanner rather than importing it, so it elaborates even when the corpus does not. That is what makes it a test of the instrument. It is therefore a vendored copy like any other and is hashed here.
conclusion_scan.what: Lean elab commands that reduce a theorem's conclusion with whnf and flag trivially inhabited ones (True, exists-True, conjunctions), plus a scan for Prop-definitions that ignore an explicit argument.
